Marta (Finance): Quick follow-up from today's vendor demo — Colin's team proposed both seat-based and committed-usage pricing. Need clarity on how pilot credits apply to overages. Anyone from procurement on this?
Kevin (Procurement): I'm on it. Do we have a sample 30-day usage breakdown? Need to model cost sensitivity for spikes and tail usage.
Colin (VendorRep): Hi all — quick answers: 
- Pilot: $5k credit applied to invoice; credits are consumed before any commit amortization.
- Commit: 6mo/12mo options, commit counts toward seat minimums.
- Overage: per-unit over commit at listed rate; we can cap overage for enterprise deals.
Pricing example (sketch):
```
commit: $50k / 6mo -> 20% off list
overage: $0.0009 / embedding-unit
SLA Gold: +15% on committed price
```
Alex (Product): Can SLA uplift be scoped per-route? We only need low-latency guarantees for chat endpoints, not batch embeddings.
Colin (VendorRep): Yes — per-route SLA is possible but comes at an uplift. We can timebox a per-route SLA pilot (90 days) so you can measure impact.
Priya (FP&A): A couple of bookkeeping questions: is a commit prepaid (capex) vs monthly opex? And how are SLA refunds/credits calculated if you miss SLOs?
Colin (VendorRep): Commits can be invoiced upfront or monthly amortized — customers choose. SLA credits are monthly credits, typically 10-25% of that month's invoice tied to minutes of downtime; we provide SLO reports.
Kevin (Procurement): Can you send a mock invoice that shows amortization and how the pilot credit flows through? Procurement needs that for approval matrix.
Colin (VendorRep): Sending a mock now — https://vendor.example/mock-invoice/RI-1234 (will also DM a CSV of daily usage). Note: we can also propose an overage cap or a blended rate if that helps budgeting.
procurement-bot: Procurement queue updated — request PR-4312 created. Approvals required: Dir Procurement, Dir Finance.
Marta (Finance): Thanks — action items: 1) Vendor to share daily usage CSV; 2) Vendor to send mock invoice + amortization schedule; 3) Legal to review SLA credit language. @Kevin please coordinate. :+1:
Kevin (Procurement): Will coordinate. Tentative timeline: artifacts by EOD Wed, internal review Thu, legal ping Fri.
Alex (Product): Also adding a perf test for chat route during pilot — will include target p95 latency and token throughput in the doc.
Colin (VendorRep): Got it — I'll upload CSV + invoice before EOD Wed and am available for a 30m call if you want to walk through the amortization line items.
Marta (Finance): Great. If legal needs anything specific from finance (e.g., preferred credit wording), flag it here and I'll draft a clause.
Priya (FP&A): Please include an example amortization schedule for both upfront and monthly billing so we can see cashflow impact.
Marta (Finance): End of thread — will follow up once we have the artifacts.
